title: How to name a model in generated code
procedure: Do not write a model string from memory.
Open the provider models page listed in this sphere (primary URL).
Call the provider list-models route with the caller's key if a live check is available.
Record slug, observed_as_of (ISO date), and source URL next to the recommendation.
If sources disagree (common: aggregator still listing last month's flagship), prefer the provider docs date and say the disagreement out loud.
Never treat an alias such as latest or grok-latest as a stable production pin.
If you cannot check, emit STALE-UNKNOWN rather than a confident old slug.
invariants: Silent success against a redirected slug is a defect, not a pass.
Chat product names (ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Grok.com) are not API model IDs.
